fact: Marketing fresh and processed fish effectively requires a combination of high product quality, strong branding and smart sales strategies to leverage various sales channels
The first step in marketing fresh and processed fish is identifying the target market
Target market, local consumers: households, restaurants, hotels, supermarkets and grocery stores
Target market, wholesale buyers: fish markets, seafood distributors and exporters
Target market, online shoppers: buyers reached via e-commerce platforms and social media
Target market, export market: for a farmer who plans to go international
The second step is to develop a strong brand, built on a unique selling point, attractive packaging, and hygiene and quality assurance
The unique selling point highlights what makes the fish special, for example organic, wild-caught, sustainably farmed or premium quality
Attractive packaging for processed fish means vacuum-sealed, eco-friendly or branded packaging
Hygiene and quality assurance is shown by displaying certifications such as NAFDAC, SON or an export promotion licence, to show quality and build trust
Online marketing, social media: Facebook, Instagram and TikTok are used to showcase fish products with photos, videos and recipes
Online marketing, website and e-commerce: selling fish online via a website or listing products on food delivery apps
Online marketing, WhatsApp Business and Telegram: creating groups for direct customer orders and promotions
Offline marketing: local market sales at fish markets, supermarkets and roadside stalls, partnerships with restaurants and hotels, and door-to-door delivery to households
Promotions and discounts: bulk discounts for wholesale orders, loyalty programmes for returning customers, and seasonal promotions for festive seasons and events
The value addition offerings that expand a farmer's stream of income are smoked fish, spiced fish, fish fillets, frozen fish and marinated or barbeque fish
Distribution and logistics, cold storage and freezing: proper refrigeration keeps fish fresh, and an alternative power-generating set is needed for when the national grid fails
Distribution and logistics: an efficient delivery system partnering with couriers or using own transport, and researching export regulations and potential international markets
Processing fish into fillets, smoked fish or dried fish increases value, and selling packaged or pre-cleaned fish attracts more customers and fetches higher prices

Marketing skills include building trust with buyers, keeping records of regular customers, understanding market demand, setting competitive prices, and offering bulk discounts and premium prices for well-packaged fish
Marketing skills also include strong persuasion and negotiation with restaurants, supermarkets and wholesalers, and joining farmers' cooperatives or fish traders' associations to access more buyers
Fish must be transported in hygienic, temperature-controlled conditions to maintain freshness, with efficient delivery routes planned for home deliveries or restaurant supplies

The fish farming unit covers agriculture and agripreneurship, the agricultural value chain, investment potential, water quality and aquarium management, fish behaviour with causes and remedies, and the marketing of fresh and processed fish
An agripreneur differs from a traditional farmer by exploiting the agricultural value chain using business skills, innovation and risk-taking
Value addition definitions to know from the unit assignment are agripreneurship, agripreneur, water quality, value chain, processed fish and innovation
